decisions.executionNote: Begin elbow-up left-arm approach; orient toward the differently aligned mallet while keeping the right arm parked.
Advance above the handle with gradual wrist rotation, retaining elbow-up continuity and open jaws.
Align the downward gripper with the mallet shaft and approach its free handle end; depth remains approximate from RGB.
Lower the final short distance and close around the handle; verify retention by a subsequent lift.
Settle the closed grasp, then lift 6 cm to check whether the mallet follows before approaching the keys.
The shaft remains between the fingers after lifting. Reorient the held mallet diagonally toward the first key while keeping the left wrist in its workspace.
Lower the mallet vertically onto the leftmost red key. Contact height is estimated visually, so use a controlled descent before lifting.
Lift clear of the red key by 5.5 cm, then move one key to the right above the orange key with the grasp closed.
Strike the second, orange key with a straight controlled descent; keep the mallet orientation and closed grasp unchanged.
Lift more than 2.5 cm after the orange-key strike, then position above the third yellow key.
Bring the tip down onto the third yellow key, retaining the established strike height and closed grip.
Lift 5.5 cm clear after the yellow key, then advance to the fourth green key without dragging the tip.
Strike the fourth green key vertically, maintaining the established contact height and secure mallet grip.
Lift 5.5 cm after the green key, then move right above the fifth light-blue key while retaining the mallet.
Strike the fifth light-blue key with the same vertical stroke, maintaining the left-arm configuration and closed grasp.
Lift the mallet 5.5 cm after the fifth key, then advance above the sixth dark-blue key without dragging.
Strike the sixth dark-blue key vertically at the established height, maintaining the mallet grip and elbow-up posture.
Lift 5.5 cm after the sixth key, then advance above the seventh purple key, keeping the left wrist on its own side.
Strike the seventh purple key with a vertical stroke, keeping the mallet held and the arm configuration continuous.
Lift clear by 5.5 cm after the seventh key, then position the mallet above the eighth and rightmost magenta key.
Strike the eighth, rightmost magenta key vertically; the next motion will lift the mallet clear to finish the sequence.
